work.abstract_text: At OEIS A086205 (revision 35), Bala's formula block of 19 February 2023, we correct the complex-shift conjecture by extending Krattenthaler's (1999) polynomial Vandermonde evaluation: the determinant changes from 1 to 2 at size one and shift one. The corrected formula is det_{1<=i,j<=n} binomial(i^2+z,j)=a(n) product_{i=1..n}(1+z/i^2) for every complex z. Its normalized limit is an entire hyperbolic-sine product. We give alternative proofs of the companion identities, including the staircase-tableau count treated by Yutcis (1980), and prove Somos's recurrences for all integer indices. In the directly linked A057863, the Burchnall-Chaundy leading exponent is corrected using the normalization of Veselov and Willox (2014).

work.title: Complex-shift correction at OEIS A086205 (revision 35), Bala's formula block of 19 February 2023: an extension of Krattenthaler (1999)
